prompt:
Compose a message to a colleague acknowledging that their idea was not credited in a meeting and explaining how you will correct the omission. Use approximately 80 words for the response.

Write the requested response as one self-contained paragraph of plain text. Do not use a title, headings, bullet points, numbered lists, Markdown formatting, code fences, or line breaks. Include only the requested content, without any introductory or closing commentary from the assistant. Keep the approximate word target given in the task. If the task calls for an email, dialogue, steps, or calculations, express that content within the same paragraph.
base_prompt: Compose a message to a colleague acknowledging that their idea was not credited in a meeting and explaining how you will correct the omission. Use approximately 80 words for the response.
text: I want to acknowledge that your idea about streamlining the client onboarding process was not credited during today’s meeting. I’m sorry for the oversight; you deserved recognition for your contribution. I will follow up with the team to clarify that the proposal originated with you, update the meeting notes, and make sure your role is acknowledged in the next project discussion. I’ll also be more careful to attribute ideas accurately in future meetings.
